asset_contract.inpaint_control_policy: Uses Image Tab source image plus painted mask/source mask assets; no separate generated map is required for future adapters.
asset_contract.map_preview_policy: Phase F records map job contracts and generated map refs; pixel preprocessing remains deferred to Comfy/local fallback execution phase.
asset_contract.mask_policy: control_masks are retained only for units with mask_mode=control_mask
asset_contract.outpaint_control_policy: Uses Image Tab source image, Phase H/J source-resolution policy, padding, and optional padded canvas/mask assets; adapters may generate canvas/mask from padding.

notes: Unlocked only for txt2img/generate and img2img on active Flux/Qwen base routes. Inpaint/outpaint remain gated until route-specific conditioning proof is added.
Future family support requires exact compiler proof. Wan/Hunyuan remain provider-gated by support matrix. Flux/Qwen txt2img/img2img are now covered by controlnet_flux_qwen_conditioning.
SD 1.5 uses compatible ControlNet node shapes but remains experimental until direct V2 smoke generation is validated.
Phase B declares V1 parity boundaries; graph patch implementation is intentionally deferred to workflow patch phases.
Image 1 is the subject, Image 2 is the pose reference, and Image 3 is reserved for the DWPose map generated at runtime.
Pose Transfer applies the two selected pose LoRAs to MODEL only and does not use a ControlNet model.
Krea 2 Depth Generate route. The selected model field is a Depth Control LoRA from models/loras, not a standard ControlNet checkpoint.
One active Krea control unit is supported. Composition uses the separate Control Plus adapter; mixed Krea control stacking remains gated.
Composition / Silhouette uses a direct RGB reference image (preprocessor none) and the Krea2 Control Plus loader/encode/apply path.
Start % and End % gate control-latent projection during denoising. The Control LoRA comes from models/loras and is intent-filtered to Krea composition/silhouette checkpoints.
One active Krea control unit is supported; Depth + Composition stacking is not enabled.
Krea 2 Turbo OpenPose uses a DWPose/OpenPose map as image1 reference conditioning through TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit, then Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch and LoraLoaderModelOnly.
The Control LoRA is selected from the live LoraLoaderModelOnly models/loras enum and filtered to the verified Krea2 Turbo OpenPose naming contract.
Krea 2 RAW stays hidden for OpenPose until a compatible RAW pose LoRA is verified. One active Krea control unit remains the Phase 5 limit.

Krea 2 RAW Canny uses Neo's generated Canny edge map as a VAE-encoded NK2E in-context reference, applies the intent-bound Canny LoRA with LoraLoaderModelOnly, then wraps the sampler MODEL through NK2EInContextModelNode.
The verified public NK2E Canny checkpoint declares Krea-2-Raw as its base model, so Krea 2 Turbo Canny stays hidden.
Neo uses the preferred NK2EInContextModelNode + NK2ESetReferenceNode pair and does not compile the deprecated NK2EInContextEditNode path. One active Krea control unit remains the limit.

controlnet_tasks.execution_note: P9.2 promotes Qwen Image Edit, Qwen Rapid AIO, and Qwen Image Edit 2509 ControlNet routes across safetensors/components, checkpoint AIO, and GGUF. Qwen map control uses Qwen/InstantX or compatible standard ControlNet nodes; inpaint/outpaint use Qwen DiffSynth/InstantX adapters and must not fall back to SD/Flux behavior.

description: Structural image guidance with family-aware ControlNet maps, Krea 2 Depth Control LoRAs, Krea 2 Composition / Silhouette through Control Plus, Krea 2 Turbo OpenPose through Ostris reference conditioning, Krea 2 RAW Canny through NK2E in-context reference control, and Qwen Image Edit 2511 pose transfer.
implementation_notes: P9.3 promotes Flux Klein safetensors/components and GGUF ControlNet through Flux2/Klein Fun Union route profiles; no SD/Flux1/Qwen/ZImage fallback is allowed.

Phase 4 Qwen VAE hotfix makes VAE validation adapter-specific: DiffSynth uses only its own apply-node schema, while VAE-aware InstantX apply nodes receive the active route-owned Qwen VAE and block clearly when it is missing.

Krea2 Control Phase 1 enables Generate map control for Krea2 RAW/Turbo on native diffusion_model and GGUF loaders through Krea2ControlLoRALoader + Krea2ControlImageEncode + Krea2ControlApply. One active unit is supported; Identity Edit stacking remains gated.

Krea2 Control Phase 4 adds the Composition / Silhouette intent for Krea2 RAW/Turbo Generate on diffusion_model and GGUF routes through Krea2ControlPlusLoRALoader + Krea2ControlPlusImageEncode + Krea2ControlPlusApply, with intent-bound LoRA filtering and Start/End schedule controls.
Phase 5 adds Krea 2 Turbo OpenPose through TextEncodeKrea2OstrisEdit + Krea2OstrisEditModelPatch + LoraLoaderModelOnly. RAW OpenPose stays hidden; Krea remains single-unit.

Phase 6 adds Krea 2 RAW Canny through VAEEncode + NK2ESetReferenceNode + LoraLoaderModelOnly + NK2EInContextModelNode. Turbo Canny stays hidden because the verified public NK2E Canny LoRA targets Krea-2-Raw; Krea remains single-unit.
name: ControlNet & Pose

node_discovery.provider_gating_policy: Missing standard ControlNet base nodes gate standard routes. Krea 2 Depth requires the native Krea2 Control LoRA trio; Composition / Silhouette requires the Krea2 Control Plus trio; Krea 2 Turbo OpenPose requires the Ostris text/model nodes plus LoraLoaderModelOnly; Krea 2 RAW Canny requires NK2EInContextModelNode + NK2ESetReferenceNode + LoraLoaderModelOnly + VAEEncode. Missing route-specific nodes gate only the matching intent.
node_discovery.krea2_nk2e_model_catalog: LoraLoaderModelOnly.lora_name from ComfyUI/models/loras, intent-filtered to NK2E Canny

workflow_patch_contract.graph_mutation: Standard ControlNet map paths mutate route-specific conditioning. Krea 2 Depth loads the native Krea Control LoRA chain; Krea 2 Composition / Silhouette uses the separate Control Plus chain; Krea 2 Turbo OpenPose uses Ostris reference conditioning; Krea 2 RAW Canny VAE-encodes the generated edge map, sets it as the NK2E in-context positive reference, applies the Canny LoRA, and wraps the sampler model through NK2E. Qwen 2511 Pose Transfer retains its dedicated DWPose + model-only LoRA lane.
workflow_patch_contract.mutates_when: enabled payload, active route state, required nodes, required unit model, and required control image/generated map are present
workflow_patch_contract.ordering: Runs after base route model/conditioning preparation and before sampler execution. Krea route adapters preserve unrelated sampler parameters and compile only their verified intent-specific graph path.
